# PPHC Announces Acquisition of Reevemark


*Acquisition adds market-leading capabilities in litigation support, transactions, shareholder activism and crisis communications*


WASHINGTON, D.C. and NEW YORK, November 2, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Public Policy Holding Company, Inc. (“PPHC”, the “Group”, or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: PPHC), a leading global strategic communications provider, today announced that it has acquired[Reevemark LLC](https://www.reevemark.com/) (“Reevemark”) (the “Acquisition”), an elite New York-based strategic communications firm specializing in high-stakes situations ranging from litigation, crises, brand and reputational issues to restructurings, shareholder activism and transactions. Reevemark, which will keep its name, will operate as a standalone business within PPHC’s[TrailRunner International](https://trailrunnerint.com/) (“TrailRunner International” or “TRI”) group. Reevemark further strengthens PPHC’s full strategic communications portfolio, deepening its market-leading capabilities in litigation, crisis and special situations communications alongside its existing strengths in corporate and financial communications and sports, without adding overlapping or duplicative infrastructure.


**Acquisition Highlights**


- Founded in 2018 by Brandy Bergman, Hugh Burns, Paul Caminiti, Delia Cannan and Renée Soto (the “Sellers”), Reevemark provides strategic counsel for high-stakes, value-determinative and reputational matters.
- This transformational acquisition adds market-leading capabilities in litigation support, transactions, shareholder activism and crisis communications, and will be immediately earnings accretive to the Group.
- Reevemark is ranked in Band One in the Chambers and Partners 2026 Litigation PR & Communications and Crisis PR & Communications guides. Chambers has recognized Reevemark’s litigation work since 2020 and its crisis work since the guide’s launch in 2021, with all five Founding Partners individually ranked.
- Reevemark recently developed and launched Sentinel, a proprietary agentic AI simulation capability built specifically for high-stakes matters which models how key stakeholders will react to client actions and audience reactions over time.
- Adds a team of 17 professionals in New York and a roster of public and private companies, asset managers and select individuals across a broad range of industries.


**Strategic Rationale**


The Acquisition is a transformational step in PPHC’s strategy of building a portfolio of premium strategic communications and advisory businesses that help clients navigate their most consequential issues. The Acquisition follows PPHC’s July 2026 acquisition of[Tancredi Intelligent Communication Ltd](https://www.tancredigroup.com/) (“Tancredi”), a strategic communications and advisory firm headquartered in London, which also operates under the TrailRunner International umbrella. With Reevemark, PPHC brings together leading litigation communications practices on both sides of the Atlantic, positioning the Group as a global leader in the field.


Litigation communications is one of the fastest-growing areas of the strategic communications market and a discipline in which Reevemark, Tancredi and TrailRunner International hold deep, complementary expertise. Reevemark also serves as a trusted advisor to board and management teams, with market-leading capabilities in transaction communications, shareholder activism, crisis communications, bankruptcy and restructuring, drawing on decades of big-firm experience, data-driven digital insights and battle-tested best practices. These capabilities complement TrailRunner International’s corporate and financial communications platform and strengthen the Group’s offering to clients in their highest-stakes moments.


The Acquisition creates clear and immediate cross-selling opportunities. PPHC’s c.1,500 existing clients gain access to Reevemark’s specialist expertise, while Reevemark’s clients gain access to the scale and reach of the wider PPHC network across Washington, the U.S. states, London and Europe.


**Stewart Hall, CEO of PPHC, commented:**


> “Reevemark is a game-changing acquisition for PPHC. Together with TrailRunner International and Tancredi, it positions PPHC as a global leader in litigation communications — one of the fastest-growing areas of our market — and adds market-leading expertise in transactions, shareholder activism, crisis and restructurings.
>
>
> “This acquisition continues our strategy of accelerating growth through earnings-accretive acquisitions of complementary businesses in high-growth markets. Our pipeline remains strong, and we maintain significant liquidity to deliver on our growth ambitions and create long-term shareholder value.”


**Brandy Bergman, CEO and Founding Partner of Reevemark, commented:**


> “We are thrilled to join such a well-respected global group. PPHC and TrailRunner International have the platform, the reach, the people and the structure to serve more clients worldwide on bet-the-company matters. From the start, Reevemark has been built to advise clients when the stakes are highest — in the courtroom, in the boardroom and in the market. Joining TRI alongside Tancredi lets us bring that counsel to clients seamlessly on a global basis, while keeping the senior-led client service and entrepreneurial culture that define our firm’s success. For our team and our clients, this is an extraordinary next chapter.”


**Jim Wilkinson, Executive Chairman of TrailRunner International, commented:**


> “Reevemark is one of the most respected names in high-stakes communications, and its team has been on the front lines of many of the most consequential litigation, transaction and communications situations of recent years. In adding Reevemark to the Group, we bring market-leading capabilities across litigation, crisis, corporate and financial communications, and this combination takes a major step toward our ambition to build the world’s best advisory platform.”


Reevemark’s exclusive financial advisor in the transaction was GP Bullhound, a leading technology advisory firm which provides transaction advice and capital to the world’s best entrepreneurs and founders. Founded in 1999 in London and Menlo Park, the firm today has 10 offices spanning Europe, Asia and the US. (www.gpbullhound.com)


**About Reevemark**


Reevemark is an elite communications firm that provides strategic counsel for high-stakes, value-determinative and reputational matters, including litigation, crises, shareholder activism, M&A, bankruptcy and restructuring, and regulatory investigations. Reevemark’s principals design and implement comprehensive campaigns to help clients communicate effectively with their core audiences, achieve their objectives, and preserve their reputations. The firm’s strategies are underpinned by decades of big-firm experience, data-driven digital insights, and battle-tested best practices. Reevemark is consistently ranked among the top litigation support and crisis communications firms in the United States.


For more information, please visit[www.reevemark.com](https://www.reevemark.com/) .
